title: be 动词:am / is / are
summary: 英语用 be 动词表达"是/处于某种状态",是英语的第一块基石。

title: 人称代词与物主代词
summary: 分清"主格作主语、宾格作宾语、形容词性物主代词+名词",是造句的基本功。

title: 名词单复数
summary: 英语名词有单复数之分,复数形式的规则变化与常见不规则变化都要熟记。

title: 一般现在时
summary: 表达习惯、事实与常态的时态;主语是第三人称单数时动词要加 -s / -es。

title: 现在进行时
summary: 表示此刻正在进行的动作,结构是 be + 动词-ing。

title: there be 句型
summary: "某处有某物"用 there be 句型;后面的名词是单数或不可数用 is,复数用 are。

title: 一般过去时
summary: 表示过去发生的动作或状态,动词要用过去式。

title: 一般将来时
summary: 表示将来发生的动作;常用 will + 动词原形,或 be going to + 动词原形表示计划。

title: 情态动词 can / must / should
summary: 情态动词表达能力、必须与建议,后面一律接动词原形,没有人称变化。

title: 形容词比较级与最高级
summary: 形容词有原级、比较级(-er / more)与最高级(-est / most)三个等级;比较级用 than 连接比较对象,最高级前加 the。

title: 冠词 a / an / the
summary: a / an 表示泛指"某一个",the 表示特指;a 用在辅音音素开头的词前,an 用在元音音素开头的词前。

title: 疑问句:一般疑问句与特殊疑问句
summary: 一般疑问句把 be / 情态动词 / 助动词提到主语前,用 Yes 或 No 回答;特殊疑问句用疑问词开头,问人、时间、地点、方式。

title: 频度副词 always / usually / often / sometimes / never
summary: 频度副词表示动作发生的频率;位置是"be 动词之后、实义动词之前",对频率提问用 How often。

title: 介词 in / on / at:时间与地点
summary: 时间上 at 接时刻、on 接具体某天、in 接年月季节;地点上 at 接小地点、on 接表面、in 接大地点或内部。

title: some / any 与可数、不可数名词
summary: some 多用于肯定句,any 多用于否定句和疑问句;可数名词有复数,不可数名词没有,many 配可数、much 配不可数。

title: 祈使句与 Let's do sth.
summary: 祈使句以动词原形开头表请求/命令/建议;Let's + 动词原形表"我们一起做"。

title: 连词 and / but / or / so
summary: 四个基础连词连接对等成分:and 表并列,but 表转折,or 表选择,so 表因果。

title: how many / how much 与数量表达
summary: how many 接可数名词复数,how much 接不可数名词;how much 还可问价格。

title: have / have got 的用法
summary: 表达"拥有"可用 have 或 have got;英式口语爱用 have got,疑问否定借 got 或助动词 do。

title: 方位介词:in front of / behind / between / next to
summary: 描述物体相对位置的四个常用介词短语,注意 between 后接 and。

title: 钟点、星期与日期表达
summary: 整点/半点/刻钟的说法,星期与日期的介词与序数词用法。

title: 名词性物主代词与反身代词
summary: mine/yours/his/hers/ours/theirs 后不再接名词;by oneself 表"独自",enjoy oneself 表"玩得开心"。

title: be 动词 am / is / are · 要点精讲
summary: Use am/is/are to express identity and state: I use am; singular/he/she/it uses is; plural/you/we/they use are.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:The subject and the be verb must agree。

summary: Distinguish the three forms of pronouns: I/me/my, they/them/their; choose by the part of speech in the sentence.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Subject pronouns act as subjects, object pronouns as objects, adjectival possessives modify nouns。

title: Regular plural nouns · 要点精讲
summary: Rules for forming English plural nouns, plus the pronunciation-aware -es forms for special endings.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Most nouns add -s; those ending in s/x/ch/sh add -es; consonant + y changes to -ies。

title: Indefinite articles a / an · 要点精讲
summary: a is used before consonant sounds, an before vowel sounds; note that a university and an hour are decided by pronunciation.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Choose by the sound of the first letter, not the letter itself。

title: this / that / these / those · 要点精讲
summary: this/these refer to near things, that/those to far things; they must agree in number with the following noun.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Singular near: this, plural near: these, singular far: that, plural far: those。

title: there be sentence pattern · 要点精讲
summary: There is/are expresses 'somewhere there is/are something'; singular uses is, plural uses are.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:The proximity principle: be is determined by the noun closest to it。

title: Possessive pronouns my / your / his / her · 要点精讲
summary: my/your/his/her/its/our/their express belonging and are followed by nouns; do not confuse them with pronoun or contracted forms.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Adjectival possessive pronouns must be followed by nouns; nominal ones stand alone。

title: Present simple (non-third person singular) · 要点精讲
summary: The present simple expresses habitual actions; I/you/we/they + base verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Plural and first/second person subjects use the base form of the verb。

title: Third person singular -s · 要点精讲

title: Present continuous be + V-ing · 要点精讲
summary: The present continuous expresses an action happening at this moment; Listen!/Look! often signal it.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:am/is/are + V-ing indicates an action happening right now。

title: Modal verb can · 要点精讲

title: Wh- questions · 要点精讲
summary: Choose the special question word (what/where/when/who/how/why) by what is being asked.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Special question word + general question structure。

title: some / any · 要点精讲

title: Past simple of regular verbs · 要点精讲

title: be going to plans · 要点精讲

title: must / should · 要点精讲

title: Comparatives · 要点精讲

title: Superlatives · 要点精讲

title: Prepositions of time in / on / at · 要点精讲
summary: The three prepositions of time cover from point to period; remember the collocation categories.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。

title: Prepositions of place · 要点精讲

title: Coordinating conjunctions and / but / or / so · 要点精讲
summary: Coordinating conjunctions connect two parallel parts; choose by the logical relation.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。

title: Definite article the · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: the points to a specific or unique thing; zero article is used for generic plurals.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Unique things, instruments, superlatives and things both parties know take the。

title: Past simple of regular verbs · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: The past simple expresses past actions; regular verbs add -ed, often with yesterday/last week.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Regular past tense adds -ed to the base form。

title: Past simple of irregular verbs · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: Common irregular verbs' past forms: go-went, eat-ate, see-saw, buy-bought, take-took, write-wrote.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Irregular past forms must be memorized; never add -ed。

title: Future with will · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: will expresses a future action or on-the-spot decision: I will call you tonight.本课为综合测试练习,核心:will + base verb, unaffected by person and number。

title: be going to plans · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: be going to expresses an intention already planned; be agrees with the subject.本课为综合测试练习,核心:be going to + base verb expresses a plan or clear sign already arranged。

title: must / should · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: must expresses obligation or strong inference; should gives advice; both take the base verb.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Modal verbs are followed by the base verb; mustn't indicates prohibition。

title: Adverbs of frequency · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: always/usually/often/sometimes/never express frequency; mind their position in the sentence.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Frequency adverbs go before action verbs, after the be verb; How often asks about frequency。

title: Comparatives · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: Comparatives compare two things; mind the -er spelling changes of short adjectives.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。

title: Superlatives · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: The superlative compares three or more; it must take the.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Superlative: the + -est / the most; watch the spelling changes of short adjectives。

title: Prepositions of time in / on / at · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: The three prepositions of time cover from point to period; remember the collocation categories.本课为综合测试练习,核心:at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。

title: Prepositions of place · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: Prepositions of place tell where something is: in/on/under/behind/between/next to.本课为综合测试练习,核心:in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。

title: Coordinating conjunctions and / but / or / so · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: Coordinating conjunctions connect two parallel parts; choose by the logical relation.本课为综合测试练习,核心:and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。

title: because / because of / so · 综合测试(第2轮)
summary: Causal connectives: because gives the reason, so gives the result; never use both in the same sentence.本课为综合测试练习,核心:because introduces a clause, because of + noun; so introduces a result; the two cannot be used together in one sentence。

title: be 动词 am / is / are · 高频真题(第2轮)
summary: Use am/is/are to express identity and state: I use am; singular/he/she/it uses is; plural/you/we/they use are.本课为高频真题练习,核心:The subject and the be verb must agree。

title: Personal pronouns and possessives · 高频真题(第2轮)
summary: Distinguish the three forms of pronouns: I/me/my, they/them/their; choose by the part of speech in the sentence.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Subject pronouns act as subjects, object pronouns as objects, adjectival possessives modify nouns。
